itemUsage.en: Umiri Yahata, bassist of Ave Mujica. Cool-headed and thoughtful, she once moonlighted for thirty bands at the same time.
itemUsage.zh: Ave Mujica贝斯手八幡海铃，心思缜密，冷静可靠，能同时兼任大约三十支乐队的贝斯手。

itemDesc.en: You can trust her to carry out whatever you ask her to with true professionalism.
itemDesc.zh: 不管做什么都能达到专业水准，相信她吧。

description.en:
Operator Umiri Yahata has demonstrated a remarkable aptitude for bodily concealment and enemy ambush in coordination with fellow members of Ave Mujica.
The Field Operations Department has thus passed the following resolution:
This operator shall be appointed a Specialist Operator during field operations to exercise Ambusher responsibilities.
In witness whereof,
This badge is hereby conferred upon the above named.
description.zh:
干员八幡海铃擅长与Ave Mujica的成员协作配合，隐匿身形伏击敌人
根据外勤部门决议
在外勤任务中划分为特种干员，行使伏击客职责
特别颁发此证章
以兹证明

description.en: One day, Ave Mujica are practicing as usual. But after running through one song, Sakiko pauses and asks, 'Yahata-san, you seem quite distracted. Is something the matter?' Past Umiri has managed her schedule to a T, easily playing for multiple bands at once with room to spare. In recent days, however, she seems almost tired, which the entire band including Sakiko find more than peculiar. Is she still adjusting to working at Rhodes Island? Umiri is silent for a spell, then gives her response while still chewing on it. '...I'll deal with it ASAP. I have no intention of causing trouble for any of you.' 'I see. Well then, let us continue practice.' Sakiko drops the issue, while the others trust that Umiri, being Umiri, can handle whatever the problem she is having is. Practice ends, and away from prying eyes, Umiri swiftly makes for a gym. Not the typical training room used by other operators, but a set of older facilities further away from the dorms, and hardly patronized these days. Alone in the gym, dinnertime notwithstanding, Umiri uncaps a bottle of protein shake. By all accounts, that is to be her dinner tonight. Chugging the tasteless protein drink, Umiri casts an eye over her schedule. Three hours of training first, and then she is finally on break. '...That was a slip-up. I'll need to put more effort into adjusting to life here. 'Kay and the Sankta operators keep inviting me to try out sweets, and it's not like I can refuse. Which means I'll have to double my normal training amount in order to work all the excess off.' Letting out a deep sigh, Umiri sets about her final training session of the day. The Sanktas of Rhodes Island have taken a great liking to Umiri. Why? Because she is one of the few people who would go out for dessert with them (Ceobe being one of the few others, of course). Most operators politely decline their invitations, but Umiri always accepts happily with genuine enthusiasm. Truth is, she is merely being courteous too, and never takes more than a bite or two. Little does she know that those half-hearted nibbles are exactly what have been quietly fueling her rising popularity. Throwing herself into training as she works to maintain her physique, Umiri is none the wiser—her Sankta friends are carrying a Laterano's brand new Sugar Glazed Pudding Butter Croissant Tower (serves ten in Lateran units) and on the hunt for her right this moment.
description.zh:
某一天，Ave Mujica正在进行日常的练习。
一曲结束，祥子停下手中的动作，询问道：“海铃，最近你的练习状态不好，怎么总是走神？”
其他成员也觉得奇怪，海铃通常会将自己的日程安排得清晰明朗，即使身兼多个乐队的职务也游刃有余。怎么最近看上去莫名有些疲惫？难道是她不太适应罗德岛上的工作吗？
海铃稍微沉默了一下，支支吾吾没有说出具体的原因：“……我会尽快调整好，不会影响大家。”
“既然如此，我们继续吧。”祥子没有多问，大家也都相信海铃有自己的难处，她肯定能处理好。
乐队练习结束后，海铃来到了备用健身房。这里不是罗德岛干员们的主训练室，距离干员们日常活动的区域稍远，且较为老旧，所以不太有人来。
明明是晚饭时间，海铃却一人在此。她打开买来的盒装蛋白粉，今天的晚饭也同样是它。
海铃一边把味道单调的蛋白饮往嘴里倒，一边查看今天的日程安排，还有三个小时的额外身体锻炼，完成后才能去休息。
“……看来是我做得不够好，才会被大家发现。必须再多加加油，让自己赶快适应。
“萨科塔干员和小刻经常来邀请我一起品尝甜食。超过了常规摄入量的卡路里，就只能通过加倍的锻炼来消耗了。”
海铃长叹一口气，开始了今天最后的锻炼。
罗德岛上的萨科塔干员都很喜欢海铃，他们觉得海铃是少有的能跟他们一起享受甜食的人（当然还有刻俄柏）。大多数干员会婉拒他们的邀请，而海铃总是客气地试吃并且发自内心地赞叹和感谢他们。
其实海铃只是礼貌性地回应，多吃了一点点而已。没想到正是这一点，让萨科塔们对她产生了强烈的认同感——这一刻，海铃不知道，在她为了保持体形努力锻炼的时候，兴奋的萨科塔们正带着拉特兰新研发的十人份（拉特兰标准）糖霜布丁黄油可颂塔到处找她呢。
